steps: Built the canonical pre-M45 image from git archive 1d00fb61.
Created an isolated Compose stack and Administrator.
Called seedRegisters; asserted supported was false and saved its fingerprint outside the containers.
Recreated app and worker with the candidate image, retaining the Postgres volume.
Waited for readyz and signed in with the same Administrator.
Called verifyRegisters with the retained fingerprint.
actual: Migrated pin, new tables, Roles, capital, fund, Holdings and counters passed.
limitations: This local image swap exercises the register fixture only. CI runs the complete upgrade-fidelity fixture suite.
An earlier different-branch lab image was refused by the migration-journal guard before register verification; no journal repair was attempted.
